observations: Work Mode is implemented as a transient assignment context for the authenticated general user.
The hook reads employment_assignments for invited, confirmed, and active assignments.
It augments event scope from event_participants and staff_shifts.
It reads work_mode_publications and can expose publication-only work packages.
It persists the selected assignment in sessionStorage and attempts to persist work_mode data to user_sessions.
Assignment accept/decline is sent through /api/work-mode/assignments/[assignmentId]/respond.
The current hook does not expose the richer worker-action, cached-read-model, offline, or realtime behavior found in the reference build.
Defines roster member status, compliance status, employment assignment status, WorkModePermissions, WorkModeAssignment, roster models, and roster mutation inputs.
Current EmploymentAssignmentStatus includes invited, confirmed, active, completed, and cancelled.

The current type file does not include the reference build's WorkModePublication, shared shift plan, attendance read model, WorkModeAssignmentListItem, WorkModeAssignmentsPayload, or WorkModeApiResponse contracts.
Presents worker applications, engagements, assignments, tours and event access, coordinator chat, tasks, travel, lodging, and attention states.
Worker task actions include acknowledge, start, complete, and block with a required block reason where applicable.
Displays explicit unscheduled states such as on-roster schedule-not-assigned and on-tour schedule-not-assigned.

Defines WorkerApplication, WorkerChannelSummary, WorkerOperationalSummary, WorkerTour, WorkerTask, WorkerEngagement, WorkHubAttentionItem, WorkHubRecommendedJob, WorkHubHistoryItem, and WorkHubPayload.
Encodes task states assigned, acknowledged, doing, blocked, done, and cancelled.
Encodes partialSources so the UI can distinguish partial-data states.
Extends EmploymentAssignmentStatus with declined.
Adds WorkModePublication, WorkerAssignmentSchedule, WorkerSharedShiftPlan, WorkerAssignmentAttendance, WorkModeAssignmentListItem, WorkModeAssignmentsPayload, and WorkModeApiResponse.
Carries semantic hiring keys including jobApplicationId and jobPostingId on assignment-related contracts.
Uses /api/work-mode/assignments as the server-authorized read-model boundary rather than assembling the full read model in the browser.
Stores a per-user authorized snapshot in sessionStorage for resilient reads.
Revalidates on focus and visibility changes.
Optionally subscribes to employment_assignments, staff_shifts, and work_mode_publications realtime changes.
Exposes assignment accept/decline plus server-confirmed check-in, check-out, and publication acknowledgement actions.
Explicitly avoids queuing or replaying attendance writes while offline.

known_reconciliation_gaps.summary: Current main does not expose the reference build's server-authorized Work Mode read-model contract and richer typed payload.
The verified reference Work Hub dashboard is not present at the same path on current main and needs targeted reconciliation before reuse.
Current Work Mode types are materially simpler than the verified reference contracts.
Current database schema and RLS have not been fully re-audited in this baseline; no new Work tables should be assumed or created from historical planning documents until that audit is complete.
Existing messaging, notification, document, tour, event, job, and staffing integrations still require a targeted Phase audit to record exact current paths and authorization boundaries.
